data.rationale: The proposal gets the core procedure right: Restaurants, then type the location, pick the suggestion, open more filters if needed, tick the filter and apply, with location and filter as parameters. But it adds an optional step to save a restaurant to a trip, with a trip_name parameter, that isn't part of the true workflow, and that lowers its accuracy and makes the automation spec murkier.
